commits.message:
EM and nuclear polarization are now only included with the POL=1 compilation
flag to avoid the warning messages from HepRotation.

In-beam simulations are now correctly identified, triggering output of
simulated S800 data.

Fixed bug in ITDecay affecting access to transition properties
for calculating Stokes parameters of emitted gamma rays.
Added support for polarized gamma-ray physics by modifying G4ITDecay (now included as ITDecay.cc)
